parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of the clusters that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account, such as cluster IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-cluster-endpoints --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --db-endpoint-id pe-0000000000000 --describe-type AI --polar-fs-instance-id pfs-test00000 --region cn-hangzhou
